subject: SLO-aware volume forecast & $/1M target — quick recap and next steps
thread_summary: Post-demo qualification: BrightBridge provided an estimated monthly token window and peak TPS requirement. Sales clarifies hosted vs dedicated economics, $/1M token target, and next procurement steps. Internal request to approve a committed slab discount for the proposed volume.
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Cho <emily.cho@brightbridge.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 07 Nov 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: SLO-aware volume forecast & $/1M target — quick recap and next steps

Emily — thanks again for the demo today. Quick recap and the concrete asks we discussed so we’re aligned heading into procurement: 

Key points from the call:
- Expected monthly token volume (user-visible consumption): 18,000,000 tokens / month (range: 12M–25M)
- Peak concurrency / TPS: ~240 TPS (99th pct burst windows, ~10–15 minutes)
- Workload shape: conversational completions (~60% of tokens) + short embeddings at lower frequency; heavy prefix reuse for system prompts (~20% effective cache)
- SLA target: 99.9% availability, 95th/99th latency SLOs for tail latency — BrightBridge wants assurance on sustained 200+ TPS windows
- Procurement ask: target net price ~$50 per 1M tokens (before any reserved-commit discounts)

What Redwood can do / immediate clarifications:
- Hosted API can handle the baseline and bursts; autoscaling and transient burst capacity are supported, but long sustained 200+ TPS windows materially increase per-token spend vs committed capacity.
- Committed slabs: we can offer tiered committed pricing (examples below) and include KV/prefix caching best-practices to reduce billed tokens for repeated prompts.
- If BrightBridge requires predictable latency and budget for sustained 200+ TPS for long windows, we should evaluate Dedicated capacity — lower unit cost and capacity guarantees.

Proposed pricing scenarios (illustrative — exact numbers final in proposal):
- Hosted (No commit): $75 / 1M tokens (on-demand), good for pilots but expensive at scale.
- Hosted (Committed slab - 12M+): $50 / 1M tokens (12M minimum monthly commit, 12mo term)
- Hosted (Committed slab - 24M+): $35 / 1M tokens (24M monthly commit, 12mo term)
- Dedicated (reserved capacity): equivalent unit economics down to $28 / 1M tokens depending on GPU mix and term length; includes SLA-backed latency targets and isolation.

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll attach our baseline forecast template — please fill in any month-by-month seasonality or high-traffic dates. (attached: BB_forecast_v1.xlsx)
2) If you confirm the 18M expected monthly baseline and 240 TPS peak, I’ll get Marissa to run a committed-slabs price calc and return a redlineable term sheet.
3) We’ll include an SLA appendix for Dedicated/Hosted variants if BrightBridge needs explicit latency/throughput guarantees.

Attaching: BB_forecast_v1.xlsx (forecast template), draft SLA template for reference.

Thanks — NAO (Naomi)

Naomi Feldman
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0186
https://redwoodinference.com
From: Emily Cho <emily.cho@brightbridge.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@brightbridge.ai
Date: Mon, 08 Nov 2026 09:21:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SLO-aware volume forecast & $/1M target — quick recap and next steps

Thanks Naomi — this is really helpful and matches what we talked about. A couple of clarifying items from my side: 

- Numbers: confirmed baseline ~18M tokens/mo and occasional spikes to ~240 TPS (we saw 280 in one test run but that was an outlier). The 12–25M range seems right.
- Unit economics: procurement asked me to confirm whether $50 / 1M is the list or net target (they are expecting net ~$45–50 after initial discount). Can you confirm whether the 12M slab is reflected as minimum committed monthly or as a front-loaded annualized credit?
- SLA / latency: for our use case 99th percentile < 600ms for completion latency is ideal during normal traffic; during burst windows 1s is acceptable but we need predictable behavior. If dedicated is materially cheaper per token, procurement will ask for a delta to justify the operational lift.

Also: who on your side should we send the Forecast file to when we populate it? Procurement prefers both a numbers worksheet and a short note that explains assumptions used for caching and prompt shapes.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Emily
Emily Cho
Head of Platform Partnerships | BrightBridge
emily.cho@brightbridge.ai | +1 (617) 555-2122

Date: Mon, 08 Nov 2026 11:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SLO-aware volume forecast & $/1M target — quick recap and next steps

Thanks Emily — answers inline and next actions below.

- $50 / 1M: that was a target net price discussed on the call (procurement expectation). The 12M slab reference is a committed monthly minimum (12M tokens billed each month as committed usage) over a 12-month term, not a single upfront prepay — but we can structure as an annual prepay or monthly commitment depending on your procurement preference. I’ll surface both in the formal quote.

- Caching & assumptions: we estimate ~20% effective token reduction for your conversational flows with recommended client-side prefix reuse + our server-side KV caching for system prompts. When you populate the worksheet, please include an estimated percentage of prompts that are high-reuse vs one-off. That will change effective billed tokens materially.

- Latency SLOs: Hosted with autoscaling meets your normal 99th <600ms goal for the majority of cases. For sustained 200+ TPS windows where you require tight tail latency guarantees we recommend Dedicated — it provides isolation and lower variance. We can include an SLA appendix for hosted bursts but the stronger latency guarantees come with Dedicated (and better unit pricing).

Pricing (formal illustrative bands we’ll put into the quote):
1) Hosted — pay-as-you-go: $75 / 1M (pilot, no commit)
2) Hosted — 12M/mo commit (12mo term): $50 / 1M net (assumes templated usage and mutually agreed forecast)
3) Hosted — 24M/mo commit (12mo term): $35 / 1M net
4) Dedicated — reserved capacity: starts at ~$28 / 1M equivalent (depends on GPU mix and sustained TPS profile)

Who to send the populated forecast: please upload the BB_forecast_v1.xlsx to the Drive link I shared or email it to procurement@brightbridge.ai and cc marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com + me. We’ll annotate assumptions and return a redlineable term sheet within 2 business days after we have the fully-populated forecast.

Attaching draft SLA appendix and an example committed-slabs worksheet for transparency.

Best — Naomi

Naomi Feldman
